posts.author: KuriejiSyfer
posts.body:
Hello everyone! Kurieji Syfer (KS) here wanting to share some great news for you all!
For the past month or so, I have been playing around with creating 8-bit music and decided the songs I have made shall be free for all to use.
It can be used in Non-Commercial and Commercial rpg maker projects, as long as I am credited in the projects.
To grab these freebies, you will have to visit itch.io and download and extract a rpg maker XP game I made called Maternal Voyage.
DON'T WORRY!
You don't need play the game if you don't want to, as the songs will be found in the music folder of the game. If you really want to, you can open the game to see how the music is utilised as background tracks during 'battles', 'map wandering', 'victories' and 'game overs'.
I will occasionally update and add more songs whenever I manage to create anything new so keep a look out now and then.
Please don't claim them as your own, and do not sell them! That would be very much "not cool".
I'm pretty amateur when it comes to making music but I really had fun with the hobby, and most of these creations I genuinely like. It be cool to hear which of these you like, and I'm also looking forward to any future projects which actually use any of the songs here.
Also, don't hesitate to inform me if some of the music needs some editing, whether it be slight volume changes, pitch lowering or whatever. Hopefully nothing too huge of a deal. Remember, not a professional at this. Just a casual hobbyist with a sharing mood.
https://ksyfer.itch.io/maternal-voyage
Enjoy!
